definitions.explanation: A state of being happy or fortunate.

examples.japanese: {幸|しあわ}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}っています→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{幸|しあわ}せ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I'm happy when I'm with my family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→たち：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{幸|しあわ}せな⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Watching the children play energetically makes me feel happy.

notes:
{幸|しあわ}せ means happiness, good fortune, or blessing. It functions as both a noun and a な-adjective.

USAGE:
- As noun: {幸|しあわ}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧ (to wish for happiness)
- As な-adjective: {幸|しあわ}せ⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (happy time)
- As predicate: {幸|しあわ}せ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧ (I am happy)
Alternate kanji: ⟦{仕合|しあわ}せ→仕合せ：noentry⟧, ⟦{倖|しあわ}せ→倖せ：noentry⟧ (less common).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {幸|しあわ}せ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become happy
- {幸|しあわ}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel happiness
- ⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧⟦{多幸|たこう}→多幸：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}ります→祈る：01198_inoru⟧: I wish you happiness (formal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{幸福|こうふく}→幸福：02750_koufuku⟧: happiness (more formal)
- ⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧: joy
- ⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧: happy, glad (emotional state)
